the need to improve the quality of decision making in relation to watershed development and the need to develop new tools and approaches to assist this decision making process.

the need to develop new approaches to watershed development planning that are more transparent, inclusive and participatory, and that are based on a sound understanding of the biophysical and social processes that are affected by watershed development interventions.

the watershed development projects in India, which have been studied, have been effective in achieving their stated objectives, but that they have not been successful in addressing sustainability issues, and that there is a need for a new approach to watershed planning, which is based on the use of the tools described above.
there are many lessons to be learned from the experience of the two projects, which have been used to develop the new approaches to watershed development planning.
there is an urgent need for a revision in the policy and practice of watershed development in India in the light of the new knowledge that has been generated.

there is a need for a revision in the policy and practice of watershed development, in India, to take into account the need for a more holistic and integrated approach.
the tools developed in this study have been shown to provide a valuable means to assist in the planning and implementation of watershed interventions in India.
the new tools developed in this paper are useful for the management of watershed interventions.

there is a need to develop a more holistic and integrated approach to watershed development planning and implementation, and that the use of new management/disseminations tools can assist the process.
